#### What this PR does / why we need it:

kubelet has generated error logs always when it calls `(*GenericPLEG).UpdateCache`.
This PR removes false error messages from kubelet logs so that users don't confuse about kubelet's health.

The log level of the messages converted to `Error` from `Info` after https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/98990.
